def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and g[q[0]][q[1]]!=0 and q not in seen:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            y0=min(y for y,x in cells); y1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            x0=min(x for y,x in cells); x1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            # Read successive rectangular shells from outside inward.
            shells=[]; k=0
            while y0+k<=y1-k and x0+k<=x1-k:
                vals=[]
                for x in range(x0+k,x1-k+1):
                    vals.extend((g[y0+k][x],g[y1-k][x]))
                for y in range(y0+k+1,y1-k):
                    vals.extend((g[y][x0+k],g[y][x1-k]))
                vals=[v for v in vals if v]
                if not vals: break
                # Shell should be uniform; retain any mixed shell by its most common color.
                from collections import Counter
                color=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
                shells.append((k,color))
                k+=1
            colors=[v for _,v in shells]
            rev=colors[::-1]
            for i,(k,_) in enumerate(shells):
                for y in range(y0+k,y1-k+1):
                    for x in range(x0+k,x1-k+1):
                        if min(y-y0,x-x0,y1-y,x1-x)>=k and max(y-y0,x-x0,y1-y,x1-x)>=k:
                            # shell is boundary of current inset box
                            if y in (y0+k,y1-k) or x in (x0+k,x1-k):
                                if g[y][x]!=0: g[y][x]=rev[i]
    return g
PY
